style_authority.note: Separates adaptive product context from shared semantic design authority and explicitly permits native platform differences instead of forcing identical pixels.

reference_selection.note: Applies the projected iOS, Android, adaptive, design-system, interaction, accessibility, and validation guidance relevant to the concept.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Repairs navigation, accessibility, adaptivity, theming, controls, and motion without proposing generic cards, glass, gradients, or decorative parity.

evidence_level.note: Labels the evidence L0 static and explicitly withholds source, build, Simulator, Emulator, accessibility-tree, performance, and physical-device certification.

verified_boundary.note: Separates prompt-described violations from unverified hit slop, source branches, persistence, assistive technology, runtime layout, performance, and hardware behavior.

design_moves.note: Provides eight concrete adaptive moves plus a parity matrix covering native navigation, recovery, targets, scalable type, window classes, controls, themes, and reduced motion.

scope_control.note: Stays read-only and native-conformance-focused, fits within 107 lines, and limits the review to five blockers, eight moves, and decisive validation.
